title: EN16931 Semantic JSON syntax binding table
description: Format of the ESJ binding tables under model/bindings/: ubl-invoice.json, ubl-creditnote.json and cii.json. A table is a header plus one entry per business term of the semantic model, in the order of the registry, saying where that term lives in one XML syntax. It records structure only; it carries no normative prose and no rule text from any source.

format.description: Fixed format marker of an ESJ binding table.

version.description: Version of the table format, not of the bound syntax or model.

syntax.description: Short token naming the bound syntax.

syntaxName.description: The syntax in the spelling its own publisher uses.

model.description: Short token naming the bound semantic model, as in a registry file.

edition.description: Edition of the bound semantic model, character for character as the registry writes it.

rootElement.description: First step of every bound path, that is the document element of the syntax as the paths spell it.

notice.description: Attribution for the source the facts were taken from, and the statement of what was not taken.

source.description: The file and the binding within it that the entries were generated from.

generator.description: Repository-relative path of the script that writes this file.

namespaces.description: Prefix to namespace name, for every prefix a path of this file uses. The empty key is the default namespace: a path step without a prefix is in it, which XPath 1.0 cannot express and a consumer has to arrange for itself.

corrections.description: Deliberate departures from the source, each with the reason for it. Empty where the source needed none.

conventions.description: Values this project writes where the syntax requires an element that no business term of the semantic model states. Each one is a fact about the syntax: which element, under which condition, which value, what asks for the element, and where the value comes from. A writer applies them; a reader applies the read-back members of them. Empty where the syntax requires no such element.

element.description: Absolute path of the element the value is written at, spelled as the bound paths are and without predicates.

condition.description: When the convention applies. `parent-written-element-absent`: the document has the element above it and no business term states this element.

value.description: The value written. It carries no business statement and is not read back as one.

option.description: The writer setting that overrides the value, where the value is a caller's choice.

requiredBy.description: What asks for the element: `schema` for the XML Schema of the syntax, otherwise the identifier of the rule of the validation artefacts that asks for it.

term.description: The business term whose content this element otherwise carries. Absent where no term names the element at all.

notReadBeside.description: Prefixed name of a sibling element. Where this element carries exactly `value` and that sibling is present, a reader does not read it as `term`, because the document states the convention rather than the business term.

source.description: Where the value comes from, with attribution.

flagDefinitions.description: Every flag this file uses, with the one line ESJ gives it. A flag in upper case is a note code carried through from the source model; a flag in lower case is derived by the generator from the bound paths.

counts.description: What the file contains, so that a consumer can check what it read.

terms.description: One entry per term of the core registry, in the order of that registry.

extension.description: The terms of an extension registry, bound in the same syntax. Present when the tables were generated with an extension model.

reusedTerms.description: One entry per term of the core registry that a group of the extension registry carries through its reusesTerms member, in the order those groups and members are written in. Such a term is bound twice by this file: in terms, where the semantic model puts it, and here, inside the extension group. A consumer that does not load the extension reads terms alone and is unaffected by this member.

identifier.description: A business term or business group identifier of a registry.

xpath.description: An absolute path from the document element, prefixed with the prefixes of namespaces, with the predicates the source states.

kind.description: BT for a term that carries a value, BG for a group.

bound.description: Whether this syntax has a place for the term. False entries carry a flag saying why and no path.

alternatives.description: Further paths the term is bound to. A document uses one of them; which one is a question for the flags of the entry.

instanceElement.description: Groups only: the element one instance of the group is, prefixed and without its predicate.

instancePredicates.description: Groups only, and only where the bound path ends in at least one: the conditions that tell this group's instances from those of another group bound to the same element. They hold together.

components.description: The supplementary components of the term, with the path of each one relative to the element it hangs off.

role.description: The ESJ value member this component feeds.

xpath.description: Path of the component relative to `anchor`. An attribute of the value itself, or a step out of it where the syntax carries the component elsewhere.

anchor.description: The bound path the relative path starts from: the entry's own path, or one of its alternatives.
